about: workflow:act-on-my-notice: carries out one action a told notice explicitly offered, in the person's own store. Only an open action to a local path completes here (it marks the notice read and returns the path to open). An action that posts to its source app, or that needs its source road to run first, is refused, because no matching owner runs here (rule a-tool-is-only-what-the-store-cannot-do). It replaces tool:act-on-my-notice in tools/tell-the-person, which read the told-the-person records through the retired records door.

payload.label: Act on one of my notices
payload.job: Carry out one action a Trillion notice explicitly offered the person: an open to a local path (the notice is marked read and the path is returned to open), or a refusal that says which owner must act when the action posts to its source app or needs its source road to run first.
payload.produces: The open path and a read notice for an offered local open, or the reason the action was not performed.

source.from: tools/tell-the-person read-data/told.mjs (actOnMyNotice, markMyNoticesRead) and tool:act-on-my-notice, read on trillion-workshop origin/main 75fa3807fc
source.note: The old tool refused every action that was not a local open. The refusals are kept word for word, except that the tool run is now the run of this recipe. The read mark is the same write as workflow:mark-my-notices-read with no surface: it is idempotent, so a repeated press writes nothing new.

where.description: Where the person keeps these things: the store's own address

language.description: How that store is spoken to, in its own terms

credential_name.description: The vault name of the login the run uses, when it needs one

action.description: The id of the action the notice offered

submission_id.description: A UUID that names this press, so a retry is the same press

text.description: Words the person typed with the action, when the action asks for them

steps.title: Read what the store already keeps
steps.do: Speak to the store in its own language, with the login under its credential_name, and read its own description of what it holds. Submit where the told notices are kept (kept_in, or null when none are kept yet) and the names of the objects that already keep them.

steps.title: Prove the actions on the example notices
steps.do: In a throwaway place in the same store, with the same objects, keep three unread notices. seq 1 {kind: "report", title: "Notice 1", at: "2026-01-01T00:01:00Z", open: "/work/reports/1", results: {page: {sent: true}}, actions: [{id: "open", label: "Open report", open: "/work/reports/1"}, {id: "approve", label: "Approve", post: {path: "/work/api/approve", body: {id: "1"}}}, {id: "road-then-open", label: "Answer then open", opens: true}]}; seq 2 {kind: "report", title: "Notice 2", at: "2026-01-01T00:02:00Z", open: null, results: {page: {sent: true}}, actions: [{id: "foreign", label: "Open elsewhere", open: "https://example.invalid/"}]}; seq 3 {kind: "report", title: "Notice 3", at: "2026-01-01T00:03:00Z", open: "/work/reports/3", results: {page: {sent: true}}, actions: [{id: "both", label: "Submit and open", opens: true, post: {path: "/work/api/approve", body: {id: "3"}}}]}. Then run these, in order, each on the store as the one before left it, and answer each one. (1) id told:1, action open: {done: true, said: "Opening Open report.", open: "/work/reports/1"}, and told:1 is now read true, one write. (2) the same again: the same answer, and nothing new written. (3) id told:1, action delete: refused with "That action was not offered by this notice.". (4) id told:1, action approve: refused with "This action must be performed by its source app; no matching action owner is available in this run.". (5) id told:1, action road-then-open: refused with "This action needs its configured source road to run before opening; it was not performed.". (6) id told:2, action foreign: refused with "This action needs its source owner to act; it was not performed.". (7) id told:3, action both: refused with "This action must be performed by its source app; no matching action owner is available in this run.". (8) id notice-1, action open: refused with "Name the notice id and one offered action id.". Then remove the throwaway place. Submit answers: one per run, in order, as above (for (1) and (2) the answer is the same object, and for (2) the notice's state is part of its answer).

steps.title: Carry out the one offered action, or refuse it
steps.do: Check the input: id must be "told:<number>" and action must be a non-empty id, else refuse with "Name the notice id and one offered action id.". When submission_id is given it must be a UUID, else refuse with "submission_id must be a UUID so a retry is the same press.". When text is given it must be words, else refuse with "text must be words.". Read the told_the_person object whose seq is the number in id; when there is none, refuse with "There is no such notice.". Find the notice's action whose id is input.action; when it has none, refuse with "That action was not offered by this notice.". When that action has a post field, refuse with "This action must be performed by its source app; no matching action owner is available in this run.". Otherwise, when its open is a string that begins with a single / and holds no backslash, it is the destination: mark the notice read (set read true, keep any prior read_on, write only when it changes, with a conditional update that applies only where the stored item still equals the item that was read), then answer {done: true, said: "Opening <label>." (or "Opening the notice." when the action has no label), open: the destination}. Otherwise, when the action's opens is true, refuse with "This action needs its configured source road to run before opening; it was not performed.". Otherwise refuse with "This action needs its source owner to act; it was not performed.". Nothing else is written, and a refused action writes nothing.
